name: A New Pilgrimage
description: At Iansan's request, you and Mavuika help test the competition process...

steps.description: Return to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame
Test the competition process for Iansan
Try out the ball launcher with Mavuika
Return to your accommodation and rest
Go to the Stadium with Mavuika
Leave the Stadium of the Sacred Flame
Return to the starting point and talk to Iansan
Test the competition process for Iansan
Try out the ball launcher with Mavuika

dialogs.content: Here you go. What lies before you is a mock-up of the course that will be used for the upcoming tournament.
You mean... this entire thing!?
If it's for the Pilgrimage, it's gotta be grand.
That's right. I've designed this one to make use of the Stadium's maximum capacity, and I've given thought to every space, every placement, and every dimension.
See this kindling?

Contestants will have to chase it throughout the competition, encountering all kinds of terrain, and they'll prove themselves by using their abilities to overcome anything and everything that stands in their way. That's the focus of this course.
Ooh, so that's the kind of competition this is.
Yep, this round counts as a knockout round. There'll be other events as well, and the eight contestants with the highest total scores will move onto the final individual battles.
Oh, you're keeping those?
Yeah, everyone loves a good duel. It really gets the adrenaline pumping, and allows people to go all-out with their skills.
A warrior should always feel fortunate to meet their match on the battlefield, even if it only happens once in their life... No one can resist such a good fight.
That's the most Natlan thing Paimon's ever heard! This tournament, too. It's just so... you.
Oh? Why do you say that?
Well, the competition's all about chasing the kindling, and you're all chasing something, too, right?
Ooh, that's a good metaphor. That'll come in handy when I'm explaining my ideation process later...
Well, I'm glad you found this helpful.
#The benefits of having Paimon and {NICKNAME} as friends and teachers!
Alright, well... Judging by your faces... You look like you're raring to go, Mavuika, so why don't you try it first?
No problem. I'll go get ready.
Whoa, Mavuika looks so excited! She must really be looking forward to this!
She might be a little too excited about the competition...
Do you... think that she seems a little bit different? After the war and all?
Like, y'know, maybe in her sense of playfulness? She seems less serious than before. More willing to just loosen up and have fun.
Nope, you're not hallucinating. I agree!
Whoa, you heard too? So Paimon's right, right?
Yeah! The side of her that she hid during the war has now come out. Makes sense, though — everyone wants to unwind a bit after accomplishing an important goal.
She's really earned it.
Ohh, so that's why you called us over? It's all a part of your grand plan, huh...
Not exactly. I did expect Mavuika to take this one, though, so I also planned some other events for you.
You're so considerate, Coach!
Hah, spare the flattery. It'll be awkward if you end up complaining that you're tired later.
Wait, Coach, what about Paimon? Does she not even get to be a substitute?
Erm...
Ahem. You have not yet met the basic criteria to even begin training. Practice a few more years and come back, and then we'll see.
Aw, c'mooon!
I'm ready!
Alright!
People like you are awesome!
That should be enough data and feedback on my end for now. Thanks for all the help, everyone.
No, we should be thanking you. Both the mock course and the ball launcher were fantastic. I didn't know you were so good at making things like this.
Ah, you flatter me. It wasn't all my own handiwork — I contracted out a part of the work you gave me to Xilonen.
She was a little reluctant, but once I mentioned that you were the one who had asked me to find some helpers, she volunteered to help.
Looks like I also have you to thank for her negative views about me... How much would you say you contributed? Thirty percent?
Absolutely not, I'd say ten at most. Please do not blame your problems on me.
#Your attendance was a pleasant surprise, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. I didn't think you'd have time to try the ball launcher out for at least a few more days... Thanks for coming.
Hehe, you know what they say, embrace the unexpected!
Thanks for having us, Iansan.
Well, I'm just glad that you had fun. Y'know, we should probably call it a day.
I need to get going now, anyway. Those improvements won't make themselves. See you later!
Bye! See you soon!
Bye, Coach!
See you soon, Coach!
Whew, it's not every day that I get to call Iansan that... Did you see the look on her face? She almost jumped out of her own skin, ahaha!
You kinda enjoy messing with people, don't you...
Really? I never noticed.
Anyway, we've been out and about so long... You must be hungry. Come on, let's go get some grub. My treat.
Wha—? Okay, Paimon takes it all back! You're the best person ever!
Course complete!
Good job, contestant! Here, have some water!
Now that was exciting!
You're too kind. Thank you, my dear audience, and thank you, Coach!
Well, what do you think? First things first, let me just say that the enemies at the end were definitely not part of the plan... the device... never did anything before...
Maybe it can't detect anyone under a certain height...
...In which case, you would've been fine, too.
Oh... Good point.
It's a solid course, but there are a number of small problems.

For example, take the chase at the start. I feel like it's too short to separate the best from the rest. Why don't you find a few more people to test it out and adjust the distance based on their feedback?
Ooh, you're really thorough! And yeah, getting multiple opinions is a great idea!
Also, about the vertical section. It's only so-so, and contestants might get dizzy from the sudden change of direction, which might cause some of them to fall if they get motion sickness.
Also...
Got it all down.
Couldn't have spotted any of these issues without actually running the course... Thanks for your help, Mavuika. I'll keep making improvements based on these suggestions.
#That reminds me of something I was talking to {NICKNAME} about, actually — I've got a ball launcher here. Want to give it a try?
A ball launcher?
Is this one of the "other events" that you mentioned?
Yup! Ball sports are also a proud, ancient tradition here in Natlan. I've decided to use one for an event.
It's been a long time since I last saw gear like this. This game can be played by two, three, or four people, and it's a fun one.
#Want to give it a try, {NICKNAME}?
I'm game.
Great. I'll be your opponent, then.
In that case, get into position, you two, and I'll start the clock. Whoever has the higher score when the clock runs out wins.
If you're ready... Begin!
#Come on, {NICKNAME}! You can beat her!
Happy to play with you.
Thank you for agreeing to be my opponent.
That was a thrilling game! Paimon was on the edge of her seat...
As expected, you're a pro, Mavuika... I concede.
You played well. We can play a few more rounds when we have the time.
That was a thrilling game! Paimon was on the edge of her seat...
Hey there, Boss, I'm here with some guests. I'll have the usual.
Ah, Pyro Archon! Welcome, welcome. It's been a while. Glad to see you with our new heroes, too.
#Boss, this is {NICKNAME}, and this is Paimon.
Nice to meet you.
Hi there!
Hehe, greetings to you both as well. You'll have the same as before, then?
We worked out today, so yeah, that would be great.
Erm, so, what is "the usual"?
We can just have some snacks. Paimon already eats too much as it is...
#Oh, come on, {NICKNAME}! You've never been stingy even when we were low on Mora, so why are you're going after Paimon's food now that someone's treating us?
#Hahaha, you two are a riot. I get where {NICKNAME}'s coming from, though. You're too cute not to tease, Miss Paimon.
If someone's down in the dumps, your banter can cheer them right up. That's not just from me, by the way. I've heard it from plenty of other people.
#Ehh? F—For real? So, were you teasing Paimon on purpose, {NICKNAME}...?
Of course. You can eat as much as you want.
Just leave it to us! Please wait a moment — your food will be out shortly.
Alright — eat your fill, Paimon, but just remember the tournament is in three days. So try and make sure your food coma is finished by then.
What, what? Food coma? ...Hmph, dunno what you're talking about. Paimon will be there on time, don't you worry.
Seems like you've also grown fond of teasing Paimon, Mavuika.
Haha, don't worry. In the event that you do oversleep a bit, I have my ways of waking you up...
Really? You do? Uh...
Ah! Speaking of your "ways," Mavuika, you still haven't told us about how you plan to find Xbalanque!
Oh, that? It's actually quite simple.
Xbalanque is a native of Natlan. The records speak of him as a wise, brave, and upright man, and refer to him as "The First Sun."
People like that tend to be like me, passionate about competition. The more they disdain dishonest ways of winning, the more they'll celebrate a fair victory.

You could call that a trait shared by all the heroes of Natlan. They are full of energy and passion, and despise victories born of deceit. Conversely, they're constantly drawn to things that are full of hope and excitement.
You mean... Xbalanque might want to take part in this upcoming Pilgrimage?
It's not a matter of "might." He will.
It's precisely because such an important figure will be participating that we must prepare the best tournament possible.
Checking in on the various tribes was also to ensure that we'll be prepared to give him a warm welcome.
So... all we need to do is to look for him in the Stadium on that day. As the first Pyro Archon, he should have no problem running away with the whole competition.
But, isn't it a bit unfair for the Pyro Archon themselves to participate in such a tournament? After all, everyone else is just an ordinary human...
When Xbalanque ascended to archonhood, he did so as a human. I see no problem in allowing him to participate in this event as a "human" from ancient times.
Also, my ineligibility for the event is not due to being Archon, but due to my obligation to serve as host and judge.
Huh, that's kinda like your life as Archon... You haven't lost your human side, you're just too busy to indulge it...
Oh? Another good summary. I'll be sure to write it down and include it in my autobiography.
You're working on an autobiography!?
No, I was joking. Even Xbalanque didn't write one, so why would I? Still, if on the off-chance I ever did write one, you two'd definitely be in it.
Then... can Paimon have a super long title?
Sure, as long as you want.
The restaurant owner walks towards you with massive plates piled high with food in her hands, and Paimon is so excited that she can't stop spinning in the air.
So many dishes, and such huge portions, too! Paimon spies mountains of meat as well... Wowee!!
Hmm? You know this is just a normal breakfast, right?
Wait, what!?
Wait, what!?
Our Archon's always had a healthy appetite. Hehe, please enjoy the food while it's still hot. Food never tastes as good once it gets cold.
The diligently prepared dishes are extremely delicious, and the two of you immediately begin to dig in.
And before you know it, Mavuika has polished off half of the grilled meat with elegance, serenity, and astonishing alacrity.
Paimon turns towards you with a frightened look. She realizes that she has met a truly terrifying opponent. From this day forth, Paimon can no longer claim the crown of the greatest meat eater.
Judging the state Paimon ate herself into, I assume you'll be staying someplace close by?
Is that okay? Ehehe, actually, since it's so beautiful around here, we were planning to stay in the area for a few more days anyway, see the sights and all that!
Of course you can. I'll go arrange some accommodations for you, then.
Mavuika leaves the table briefly, before coming back and taking you to your lodgings.
Alright, I'll leave you here. Have a good rest.
Alright, good night!
How do you feel? Want another drink?
I'm good... I'm full.
Then... how about some dessert? Paimon still wants something sweet...
Why are you looking at Paimon like that? There's always room for dessert!
Lord Xbalanque is coming back, huh? Well, I didn't see that coming... Wait, what's that look on your face? Don't tell me you don't even know who Xbalanque is?
What kind of idiot do you take me for!? I was just thinking about it!
I mean, we just managed to defeat the Abyss for good, and fulfill the wish of all citizens of Natlan, past and present... So why is he coming back now, of all times?
Yeah, if he's here to help, the war's already over. And if he isn't...
...Uh, I just had a terrifying thought. What if he's actually some kind of villain who's come to steal our victory? Isn't that how the novels usually go?
What? No! Don't be ridiculous! Novels are just fiction! Don't you slander our great hero. You're talking about Lord Xbalanque here, the one everyone calls The First Sun!
Also, even if what you said were true, I don't think our Archon would lose! We all saw that one punch of hers. The power in it was like... Hah!
Yeah, I agree, but I'll bet Lord Xbalanque's no slouch, either! Say, if they fought, who do you think would win?
...Argh... Well, you've got me there.
Well, as someone living in this age, I've got to vote for our Archon, right? Live in the now, seize the day, and all that.
Man, now that you mention it, a fight between those two is bound to be a terrific one... What I wouldn't give to watch!
Alright, enough of that nonsense. It's already super late. If we keep hyping ourselves up, neither of us are gonna get any sleep tonight!
The way they're talking about the archons duelling each other almost makes it sound like a beetle battle...
Way more exciting than a beetle battle, that's for sure.
Yeah! They really do love their contests of strength here in Natlan...
(I'm looking forward to the tournament myself. How will the matches go? And who's going to come out on top?)
(Will the legendary Xbalanque really participate? If he wins the whole thing, will Mavuika preside over the victory ceremony, too? The more I think about it, the more interesting it gets...)
Phew! Alright. Paimon's done eating. Let's head back and get some sleep!
You and Paimon spend the next three days strolling around, eating, drinking, and relaxing to your hearts' content...
At last, the day of the tournament arrives.
That was a thrilling game! Paimon was on the edge of her seat...
I managed to force the great Pyro Archon to a draw!
Indeed you did. I've noticed that you're very good at games. And now that I've found such a great opponent, we've got to have a rematch sometime.
...Hey! Wake up! Wake up! The tournament's about to start!
(...That voice... Ah, it's Paimon...)
(Wait, the tournament!?)
Oh no, we've overslept! Only a little bit, but... Okay, wash up and pack your things! We've gotta go go go!
Aaaaaah, Paimon can't believe it, Mavuika totally called it! How could we have been so careless!?
Is this what people mean when they say you can get so excited before a trip that you struggle to sleep the night before, only to miss setting out the next day...
Hey there. How are you feeling?
Mavuika! Why are you here!? Isn't the tournament about to begin?
We know, it's our fault! We're really sorry!
Yeah, we're about to start. I'm here to pick you up.
Put on your helmets, and get on the bike.
Huh? Can we make it in time?
I'll hang on to you, Paimon, don't worry!
We'll take a shortcut.
Sit down and sit tight. You can hold on to my waist if you get scared.
Paimon doesn't count as a passenger, so we're not overloaded!
Woohoo! Annnd SAFE! Just in time, too!
We won the bet! We won the bet!
That's right! Pay up, Ajaw!
Yeah, pay up, Ajaw!
Pay up.
Tch! Darn it...
Aaaaaah— Oof!
How'd you like that? A short flamestrider show to start us off, and to introduce and welcome Natlan's great friend, "Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini"!
Woohoo!!
Sure pulled off that stunt pretty neatly.
How can you call that a stu— Wait... What do you mean, "pulled it off"? That wasn't supposed to be part of the show?
Everyone, welcome back to the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame. Once more, I will say a few words before we begin.
Bored? Heard it all before? Not to worry. We're doing things differently from now on.
The Abyss no longer threatens us day and night as it once did. My comrades, my friends, thank you for your hard work and sacrifice. We have achieved a lasting victory. A new day has dawned on Natlan!
Woooooo!
From now on, the Pilgrimage will no longer serve as the prelude to a war waged to defend our land. However, many aspects of it will remain the same.
It remains a trial to determine the strongest among us, as well as a stage upon which to showcase your individual growth.
Today marks the beginning of yet another legendary saga — one written in the triumphs of the victors! So, without further ado... Let the tournament begin!
Yeah!!
Heck yeah!! Who's gonna be the new champion!?
Now then, you two. You'll be mobile supervisors, moving with the contestants as they progress, and making sure that everything is proceeding fairly and in good order.
Leave it to us! We're the best adventurer and travel guide duo you'll ever meet!
Oh, and one more thing. I believe I've mentioned this already, but...
If you find any leads on Lord Xbalanque, please pass them onto me.
Will do.
Thanks. I'm counting on you.
Hey, Kinich! Gonna take part in the tournament?
Of course. I wouldn't dream of missing such a rare opportunity.
Best of luck! You can do it!
Hmm... Where's Ajaw, though?
I locked him in a chest. I'm going to win the tournament solely on my own merit, so he's not needed during the competition.
Aha! Hmm, on a different note, have you heard anything about Lord Xbalanque?
I've looked all over, but haven't seen anyone that struck me as being on his level.
Let's touch base again later, then.
Sure.
Hehe, you're reliable as always, Kinich! We should go check with the others now, so we'll see you later. Good luck, and make sure you don't get injured!
Appreciate it. Wish you guys every success as well.
Ooh, hi there, Iansan! Are you gonna participate in the tournament?
No, as the designer of this course, that's out of the question.
I'm here to cheer everyone on and monitor the pre-event warm-up. Contestants must limber up properly if they don't want to get injured.
That's fair. Can we ask you something, then? You know about Lord Xbalanque's resurrection, right? Have you seen anyone with that kind of aura over here?
Yeah, the others told me about it.
I've kept an eye out, but haven't noticed anything unusual. At least, I haven't seen any contestant whose strength or skill is clearly a cut above the rest.
Got it, thank you! We'll keep asking around, then.
You're welcome... Wait, one moment!
Huh?
You warm up as well. You'll be running alongside them in the Stadium, so you've got to go in prepared.
Stretch! Lower! Again! Good!
Iansan corners you, and coerces the two of you into going through a round of warm-ups. Her coach's aura is simply too commanding to resist.
Alright, you're good. You may go.
Ah, thank you, Coach... Paimon feels like even her blood is boiling...
Hmm...
Hah—!
Whoa!!
#Oh? Well, hey there, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. What brings you here?
To see the lovely Miss Itztli.
You...! Hmph, I'm not buying what you're selling!
#{NICKNAME} means it!
Still, Paimon didn't think you'd be taking part, Citlali. Given who you are, are you sure it isn't against the rules?
Though not a violation per se, what it will be is an unpleasant surprise for the youngsters.
Normally, I stay out of this kind of event — don't want to put too much pressure on everyone else. But we're celebrating the end of the war here, so I'll give the occasion the respect it deserves.
Good luck, then! Make sure you show off your super-majestic side, alright?
Well, aren't you the sweet-talker today? Too much syrup on your pancakes this morning?
Anyway, thank you both. I'll remember your words of encouragement, and do my best.
So what was that "Hmm... Hah!" thing all about? Some kinda strange ritual?
Of course not. I was using my power to search for Lord Xbalanque.
To be more precise, I was trying to look for him in the world of souls. After all, I also have no idea what he might look like...
But why? He is the first Pyro Archon, after all, isn't it a given that he'll be revived with an unimaginably large amount of power?
Seems like we'll have to keep looking.
Yeah, we don't have any leads yet... We'll check for leads somewhere else. Good luck, Granny, and take care!
Be on your way, now. Oh, and take care of yourselves, too. Granny Itztli will display her dashing self on the competition grounds soon enough.
One, two, three four, two, two, three four...
How's the warm-up going, Kachina? Feeling good?
Oh, hey you two! Yeah, I'm feeling great! Ready to get out there and show 'em who's boss, hehe!
Good luck! Bring it home.
Mhm! I'll give it my all!
I mean, I don't know if I'll be able to win again, but as long as I learn something from the experience, that's enough of a win for me!
Yeah, having the right mindset is everything!
Yup!
Oh, by the way, have you seen anyone who seems like Lord Xbalanque?
Lord Xbalanque? Hmm... I don't think so!
A powerful figure like him is sure to attract attention wherever he goes. Like Mualani and Kinich — only even more so.
I haven't seen anyone like that, though... So he probably hasn't passed this way.
Ahh, alright... Thanks, Kachina! We'll go take another look around. Focus on taking care of yourself as well as winning!
I will, thank you!
We're back!
Supervisors, your report, please. How are the contestants doing?
Madam host, the contestants are doing great, and the competition is proceeding as scheduled!
However, when it comes to Xbalanque...
No leads, huh... The competition is almost about to begin, and there's still no sign of him?
Not what you expected?
Not necessarily.
Still, let's go give everyone a warm welcome before we kick off.
I believe we're all warmed up. Now, take your positions.
This iteration of the Pilgrimage is the perfect chance for us to bid farewell to the past. Now, go forth and soar, faster, higher, stronger — become a better version of yourself.
Remember what brought you here, and keep pushing forward. This tournament begins... now!
Alright! Ready or not, here I come!
Waaah!!!
There's Mualani, a natural sports star! She's not going to stop scoring anytime soon!
I've got this!
This round's in the bag!
A vertical course, huh...
Time to leave them all in the dust.
Kinich is coming up to the trickiest parts of the course here, but is he slowing down? NO! He's SPEEDING UP! Amazing!
How's he so fast!?
See you later.
The gap between our competitors has increased significantly! Could this mean...
Hah!
Ooh! Contestant Kachina has suddenly appeared from the side!
This part's rough... but I won't give up!
Ugh! So annoying...
The competition has entered its final phase! Who will emerge victorious? We're about to find out!
Got you!
Aghhh!
Well? Do you yield?
*sigh* I yield!
Our champion has emerged! And his name is... Kinich!
Kinich! Kinich!
That's amazing! Woohoo!
Yeah, that's our Kinich! I knew he'd win!
What!? So not only is the little punk hard to kill, but he's good at fighting too? Hmph. Guess he does have some skill...
You beat me fair and square, Kinich... People always talk about how tough you are, and now I can say for sure: they're not exaggerating.
It's funny, I was thinking to myself earlier that I might have a shot at winning this... unless I have to face Kinich in the final.
Come on, dude! What are you talking about?
Pfft, losing to Kinich isn't really a loss at all!
You've more than proven yourself, too! You could beat me up thirty times over!
Ha. Hear that? They're recognizing your strength as well.
Keep up the good work. Let's have a rematch sometime.
Yeah!
They're both so good... But wait, if that's the end, where's Xbalanque?
Wait, aren't we missing someone? Ah! Lord Xbalanque!
Now that you mention it... Where is he? Don't tell me...
What's with the looks on your faces? I might have won, but I'm not Xbalanque.
Huh!? Are you saying that you BEAT Xbalanque, then? Urgh, just kill me now! Better death than to suffer this torture! What a joke!
Hmm. You might be onto something... I've never met our runner-up before. So... Where did you get this good?
That's impossible, right? Could he have placed so well because of some connection with Lord Xbalanque?
You mean... He might be Xbalanque?
Wait, I'm Xbalanque now? Heh, that's news to me.
I've got it! Lord Xbalanque didn't want to steal anyone's thunder, so he must've lost the tournament on purpose!
Wait, that doesn't make any sense. This is the most holy Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame! How could anyone throw a match?
Whoa, did Paimon say something wrong? Now everyone's talking about Xbalanque...
Still, that guy was almost too good, wasn't he? We've never heard of him before, but he was still going toe to toe with Kinich. Could he really be...?
Huh? What are you looking at, Mavuika?
I've felt that something was off since the tournament began.
Reflecting back on it, it wasn't because I could sense Xbalanque's power, but rather that... I could not.
(Does she mean that Xbalanque is not present? Or... does she mean that he wasn't resurrected in his original form?)
Please, excuse me.
Wait, she's going... straight in the direction of the other contestants?
There you are.
No unimaginably strong soul aura, nor any whiff of extraordinary power...
But I know, beyond any doubt, that you are Xbalanque himself.
Huuuuuuh!?
Wh—Who's that? I've never seen him before...
Isn't that Mausau? Like, Tawto's grandson? When did he sign up for the tournament? Did he even fight anyone out on the field?
What are you talking about? He's been standing there this whole time. I totally thought he was just there to cheer the others on...
Wait, so THAT'S Xbalanque? But... he's just a kid...
Ahem...
Hah! HA! Well, this kid doesn't look like he can take a single punch from the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw! Just give me one second, and I'll...
Huh? That's Lord Xbalanque? But... I mean, he was right next to me for most of the tournament. And he didn't seem very, well... Xbalanque to me...
...You recognized me? Perceptive. No less than expected of this era's Pyro Archon.
Forgive me for asking, but how did you do in the latest tournament?
Haha, I didn't even make it to the final 32.
Noooooo!
This is a joke, right? It has to be! It's clearly staged!
Out of my way! I've got to see Lord Xbalanque for myself!
As expected, your return has caused quite the commotion.
Less talking, more doing! Hurry up and take Lord Xbalanque to a safe place. I've got this place covered.
Please remain calm, everyone. Lord Xbalanque is one of the most important people in all of Natlan. I will take responsibility for receiving him into our midst.
You heard the Archon! Just leave this to her. Don't worry, we'll let you know as soon as we know more!
(Mavuika seems to be signaling Paimon and I to follow her...?)
Ah, she's calling us! Quick, let's go!
Hey! Wait up!
Thank you for agreeing to be my opponent.
Huh? Did you go the wrong way?
No worries, we can just start over again. Let me know when you're ready.
Warming up before a competition is extremely important. Don't ever forget.
Without him around, it's so peaceful and quiet.
Phew... Not bad.
Hmph, this will be a walk in the park.
Don't worry about me! I'll do my best.
